engine: Godot 4.6.3 headless; local CPU timings, not Android measurements
scenario: Seven stone cells, then append one stone
cause: Large decoration candidates were fully rasterized before rejecting them for radius or tile bounds.
changes: Reject oversized uniform candidates using exact cached source radius.
Reject outside-canvas candidates using exact convex-hull raster bounds.
Reuse unchanged placement plans without repeatedly serializing their entire catalog for cache lookups.

validation.prior_placement_fingerprints: All seven profiled stone plans match the previous implementation.
